mechanism: Dexamethasone increases amphotericin B nephrotoxicity by enhancing renal vasoconstriction and electrolyte wasting, while amphotericin B's nephrotoxic effects are potentiated by corticosteroid-induced immunosuppression and electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor renal function closely with baseline and frequent serum creatinine/BUN; ensure aggressive hydration; monitor electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium); consider alternative antifungal if possible or use lowest effective dexamethasone dose.
